items.question: How can a mind fixed on that remain uncut when the body is being severed?
premises: The body may be undergoing severance at a given time.
A mind fixed on that object remains oriented elsewhere.
That orientation prevents the act of cutting from affecting the mind.
items.inference: A mind fixed on that is not subject to being cut even as the body undergoes severance.
uncertainties: Extent to which fixation blocks effect remains unspecified
items.plain_english: Even as one is being cut, one is not cut if one's mind is fixed on that, just so.
